name: blaze-sentinel
desc: Reports SELinux/AppArmor state, Secure Boot, kernel lockdown, firewall and kernel hardening sysctls; supports --json and verify exit codes.

name: blaze-continuum
desc: CRIU based freeze/restore of a window or session into a .blz-state capsule and LAN transfer over BCTP/1, with a Ghost Overlay surface. Experimental.

name: blaze-recovery
desc: Graphical recovery environment (BERE) with swipe-to-confirm actions, recovery backend and the terminal Screen of Death.

name: blaze-house
desc: Iced based system control center (displays, storage, optimization, ZRAM, battery, network, bluetooth, sound, security, users, accessibility, language).

name: blaze-tools
desc: Post-install, desktop provisioning, NVIDIA/Waydroid/Limine helpers, bootloader switcher, optimizer, session diagnostics and the solar-torture soak test.
